title: The Zephyr Project Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the…
description: The Zephyr Project Manager plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the 'zpm_profile_picture' parameter affecting all versions up to and including 3.3.209. Authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher can inject malicious scripts that execute in administrator browsers when the autocomplete mention lookup renders the avatar field. Exploitation requires an administrator to view the injected content, as the attacker cannot trigger the vulnerability alone.
